_metadata.description: Requirements for private bundled runtime behavior and fail-closed desktop evidence.

requirements.title: Structural bundled API routing
requirements.description: When a bundled UI service receives a request, it MUST serve bundle assets and the health path locally and route every other request to the bundled API without naming a scenario, protocol-specific path shape, or path-prefix allowlist.

validation.notes: Planned routing table test and bundled web-console evidence.

requirements.title: Allowlisted bundled child environment
requirements.description: When a bundled child starts, it MUST receive only the documented environment allowlist and bundle-manifest variables.

validation.notes: Planned renderer and preflight environment tests.

requirements.title: Observed bundled isolation
requirements.description: When a bundled child reaches readiness, the run MUST record its resolved state root, socket path, database path, and adopted host-session count and MUST refuse a live resolved path.

validation.notes: Planned isolation derivation tests and bundled manifest evidence.

requirements.title: Fail-closed journey surface assertions
requirements.description: When an input chapter has identical captures without a passed application assertion, or captured frames contain a surface error, the journey MUST fail with the corresponding observed reason and MUST NOT report pass.

validation.notes: Planned chapter assertion tests, negative control, and fresh bundled evidence.
